snippet.title: Jingle Janitor | Official Trailer | Cozy Christmas Tidying Game with Couch Co-op
snippet.description:
Your first night as Santa's janitor, and the elves partied all night. Jingle Janitor is a cozy first-person tidying game: sort a gloriously messy workshop until every toy part sits on its shelf, learn handy magic, cheer up the elves and save Christmas. Alone, or with a friend on the couch.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5445800/
Coming December 2026.

What's in the workshop:
- 2,225 toy parts, and every single one has a home
- Magic: Gravity Magic, the Gingerbread Crew, the Christmas Miracle and more
- Couch co-op in split screen
- Ride the Elf Express, play giant Christmas chess, start a snowball fight in the yard
- Accessibility built in: rebind every action (keyboard, mouse, any controller), toggles instead of holds, aim assist, text size, high contrast, captions and reduced motion
- English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish and Russian

Made by Dreamt Madness, a two-person indie studio.
https://dreamtmadness.com/games/jingle-janitor/

#JingleJanitor #CozyGames #IndieGame
